system.description: You have trouble distinguishing between real memories and fake ones —or ones that do not belong to you. Ths disorder has grown more common thanks to resleeving and the potential integration of memory artifacts in a morph’s brain from a previous user to a later one. Some asyncs recall memories that are not transhuman.
system.triggers: Alienation, immersion in water/vacuum, sex, the unknown

effects.description: You recall memories that are not real or not your own, or you may be confused about who, what, or where you are. Any superior failure on a skill test will result in you confusing important details.
